mapper.select: SELECT /*LGSETC00030.retrieveCodeValueList*/ a.company_id , a.code_type_code , a.inventory_organization_id , '' inventory_organization_id_name , a.common_code , a.common_code_desc , a.sort_order_no , a.use_flag , TO_CHAR(a.apply_start_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS apply_start_date , TO_CHAR(a.apply_end_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS apply_end_date , a.parent_common_code , a.parent_code_type_code , a.code_data1_value , a.code_data2_value , a.code_data3_value , a.code_data4_value , a.code_data5_value FROM lgcom_common_code_c a WHERE a.code_type_code = #{codeTypeCode} ORDER BY a.sort_order_no, a.common_code, a.company_id, a.inventory_organization_id

SELECT lcc.language_code , lc.common_code_desc , lcc.common_code_name , lc.code_type_code , lc.common_code , lc.company_id , lc.inventory_organization_id FROM lgcom_common_code_c lc ,lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c lcc WHERE lc.common_code = lcc.common_code AND lc.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lc.company_id = lcc.company_id AND lc.inventory_organization_id = lcc.inventory_organization_id AND lc.use_flag = 'Y' AND lc.common_code = #{commonCode} AND lc.code_type_code = #{codeTypeCode} AND lc.company_id = #{companyId} AND lc.inventory_organization_id = #{inventoryOrganizationId}
SELECT lod.organization_id AS code , lod.name AS name FROM lgcom_company_v lod ORDER BY 1
